answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring every identity to complete a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings and provide a verifiable Wesolowski proof. A single chain cannot be shortcut by splitting its dependent steps across GPUs, so each clone incurs a real elapsed-time cost; running many clones concurrently still requires separate computing resources. Inputs such as “garden,” “walnut,” and “timber” do not remove this bottleneck.
